title: Paraguay: Historical Drought
organization: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)
temporal_coverage: National drought history and vulnerability indicators through 2023; the page cites severe droughts from 1960–2022.
methodology: FAO's national drought case-study page was read in full; it summarizes drought impacts and selected national indicators.
limitations: Undated page synthesizes cited material with mixed vintages; indicators are not all locality-specific.

title: Country Climate and Development Report: Paraguay
temporal_coverage: Report published 2024; combines historical observations, cited statistics, modeled projections, and policy diagnostics.
limitations: Historical, cited and modeled material have varying vintages; local sample detail is limited.

title: Desafíos del sector agua, saneamiento e higiene ante el cambio climático de Paraguay
organization: UNICEF Paraguay and Dirección de Agua Potable y Saneamiento (DAPSAN-MOPC)
temporal_coverage: Published November 2024; reports WASH coverage and a climate-risk assessment informed by consultations and earlier policy and climate material.
methodology: Full UNICEF/DAPSAN report; combines policy and climate review, WASH analysis and workshops.
limitations: Some indicators and projections are earlier-source material; conflicts lack case detail.

title: Indigenous Climate Action Plan and Disaster Risk Reduction
organization: Federation for the Self-Determination of Indigenous Peoples (FAPI)
temporal_coverage: Indigenous plan validated by FAPI member associations on 2020-10-16 and published in November 2020; includes community accounts and proposed actions.
methodology: Full English translation of FAPI Indigenous plan inspected.
limitations: Qualitative member accounts are not representative; proposals are not implementation evidence.
